dependency_assessment.conclusion: No further matrix entry is indispensable to implement and verify this family. pane.focus and surface.split are required regression dependencies because they consume the migrated model, but their parity rows are not claimed in this batch. Existing window/workspace routing, browser/terminal runtimes, event transport, and session persistence are infrastructure dependencies, not additional parity entries. The family therefore remains within the exact 14 requested entries and below the 15-entry ceiling.
dependency_assessment.reason_for_expansion: The earlier adapter/read cuts were false boundaries. list/current consume the same heterogeneous surface model that pane/surface create, action, close, focus, move, resize, and respawn mutate; report_pwd requires arrival-time reconciliation and lifecycle cleanup/transfer; the CLIs are direct façades over action/respawn. Existing close/focus/move/resize implementations must be regression and differential rows because the model migration can silently break them.

regression_dependencies_not_claimed.v2:pane.focus: Must remain green because it consumes pane identity/focus produced by the migrated model; no matrix status claim is made in this batch.
regression_dependencies_not_claimed.v2:surface.split: Must remain green because it creates pane/surface lifecycle state through an existing entrypoint; no matrix status claim is made in this batch.
regression_dependencies_not_claimed.rule: Regression coverage may exercise these methods, but evidence and promotion are limited to the exact 14 scoped rows.

authoritative_model_migration.objective: Replace pane-shaped and parallel-metadata approximations with one authoritative per-surface lifecycle that can reconcile persisted snapshot identity, live runtime attachment, remote arrival, directory reporting, actions, respawn, and close/move cleanup without duplicate state.

surface_record.identity: stable public surface id plus owner window/workspace/pane and pane-local order; public identity remains stable across runtime replacement such as respawn
surface_record.selection: pane-selected is separate from workspace-focused; multiple panes may have selected surfaces but exactly one workspace-focused surface

heterogeneous_kind_union.terminal: requested working directory, initial command/input/environment, tmux start command, runtime process/PTY, resume/agent state
heterogeneous_kind_union.browser: URL/profile/history/render state/developer tools and duplication/reload runtime
heterogeneous_kind_union.agent_session: provider, renderer, working directory, agent lifecycle
heterogeneous_kind_union.markdown_file_diff_project_sidebar: kind-specific file/session identifiers without pretending they are terminal/browser state
heterogeneous_kind_union.remote_terminal: remote PTY/tmux identity, remote provenance, arrival generation, pending directory-report application

authoritative_model_migration.pane_record: Stable pane id, ordered surface ids, selected surface id, layout-tree position/divider geometry, container kind (workspace or Dock). Pane metadata must not be copied onto every surface.
authoritative_model_migration.indexes: Maintain owner indexes surface->(window,workspace,pane), pane->(window,workspace), and runtime-handle->surface. Every mutation updates all indexes atomically with the snapshot.
creation_reconciliation: Reserve stable ids and intended ownership/order before starting asynchronous terminal/browser/remote runtime creation.
Attach runtime only if lifecycle generation still matches; stale callbacks after close/respawn are ignored and cleaned up.
For remote tmux create/split, return accepted/routed with null created id where canonical does, then reconcile the arriving remote surface by authoritative remote identity without duplicating it.
Apply pending PWD metadata exactly once when the matching requested or uniquely resolvable surface arrives.
Emit lifecycle events from committed state transitions, not from both request adapter and runtime callback.
restore_reconciliation: Decode panes, ordered heterogeneous surfaces, selection/focus, metadata, and kind-specific state into the authoritative model before launching runtimes.
Recreate/attach runtimes against stable restored ids and lifecycle generations; do not mint replacement public ids on restore.
Preserve canonical persisted fields (directory/provenance, titles, pin/unread, terminal startup/resume, browser state) while treating runtime handles as transient/derived.
Prune orphan metadata and pending reports whose owner lifecycle is definitively closed; transfer all surface metadata atomically on move/detach.
close_move_respawn_invariants: Close removes surface owner indexes, runtime, pending directory reports, and metadata once; pane collapse and focused/selected fallback are one transaction.
Move/detach transfers the same public surface id and all heterogeneous metadata/runtime ownership without duplication or loss.

Respawn is terminal-only, replaces the runtime behind the same public surface id, invalidates stale callbacks, preserves appropriate surface metadata, and applies the requested startup inputs atomically.
Pinned close-range actions skip protected tabs and never delete the last surface.
windows_current_model_gaps: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/control_socket.rs derives surfaces by walking pane snapshots and frequently routes through snapshot.windows.first.
Pane surface_kind is used for every panel in a pane, which cannot represent canonical heterogeneous horizontal tabs reliably.
Parallel panel_titles/pins/unreads/startup arrays can drift from pane order/runtime arrival and require manual pruning.
Current list marks each pane-selected surface focused and returns many noncanonical fields while missing canonical index_in_pane semantics.
No shared arrival hook owns pending PWD reconciliation, runtime generation, action/create/respawn events, and restore together.

shared_canonical_rules.identity_refs: Public ids are UUID strings and *_id values accept UUID or minted kind:N refs unless an entry-specific quirk says otherwise. Responses pair UUID/ref and use explicit nulls.
routing_precedence: present non-null window_id; invalid/unresolved is terminal and never falls through
shared_canonical_rules.focus: Reads, directory reporting, and default mutations do not activate or raise windows. focus=true and surface.focus are honored only through canonical explicit-focus policy and only by branches that support destination focus.

browser_disabled.no_url: browser_disabled / cmux browser is disabled / null
browser_disabled.external_failure: external_open_failed / Failed to open URL externally / {url}
browser_disabled.external_success: window id/ref; workspace/pane/surface ids+refs null; created_split=false, opened_externally=true, browser_disabled=true, placement_strategy=external_browser_disabled, url

shared_canonical_rules.remote_tmux: Reject unsupported options before mutation. Successful routed create/split returns accepted=true, routed=remote-tmux, type, window/workspace ids+refs, and null pane/surface created identities until the remote arrival event reconciles state.
shared_canonical_rules.events: Lifecycle events come from authoritative model transitions. Successful surface.action/tab.action additionally maps to one surface.action socket-domain completion event; failures and surface.current/list/report_pwd do not emit completion events.

entries.contract: End-to-end create, attach, select/focus, heterogeneous metadata, action, directory reconciliation, pane resize, respawn, move/detach, close, restore, and multiwindow ownership use the authoritative model migration above.
observable_requirements: Pane order/geometry and surface order/selection/focus are mutually consistent across every API and UI snapshot.
Terminal, browser, agent, markdown/file/diff/project/sidebar, Dock, and remote surfaces retain kind-specific metadata without pane-wide leakage.
Creation and restore callbacks reconcile by stable identity/generation; no duplicate or zombie runtime appears.
Close/move/respawn atomically clean up or transfer metadata, pending directory reports, runtime indexes, events, and persisted state.
Two-window and Dock ownership is exact and non-focus commands preserve focus.
entries.windows_gap: missing product behavior; existing independent helpers and parallel arrays do not establish one reconciled lifecycle

request.routing: shared selectors; source is a raw UUID-only surface_id quirk, else workspace focused surface

errors: invalid_params/placement must be one of: workspace, dock with placement data
invalid_params/agent-session is only supported by surface.create with type data
entries.success: Created workspace pane returns window/workspace/pane/surface ids+refs and type. Dock success returns placement=dock, ordinary pane/surface ids null, dock_pane_id nullable, dock_surface_id, type. Remote route and external-browser success use shared shapes.
entries.state_events_persistence: Creates a new pane and first heterogeneous surface adjacent by direction, records divider, optionally focuses, emits pane.created and surface.created (plus selection if changed), and persists layout/kind/startup metadata.
entries.windows_gap: missing exact method; existing surface.split has different direction/response/errors and relies on the unreconciled pane-shaped surface model

request.routing: shared routing; pane_id else focused pane
request.absolute: If either absolute_axis or target_pixels is present, require axis horizontal|vertical and finite target_pixels > 0.
request.relative: Otherwise require direction left|right|up|down and integer amount > 0 (default 1).
request.precedence: Absolute intent wins over relative fields.

errors: invalid_params/direction must be one of left|right|up|down and amount must be > 0
not_found/Workspace not found or No focused pane or Pane not found or Pane not found in split tree
invalid_state/No split ancestor for absolute pane resize
invalid_state/Pane has no adjacent border in direction <direction>
entries.success: Return window/workspace/pane/split ids+refs, old_divider_position, new_divider_position, plus absolute_axis+target_pixels or direction+amount. Divider movement is clamped to 0.1...0.9.
entries.state_events_persistence: Mutate the correct split ancestor in the authoritative pane tree, emit the canonical pane resize event once, preserve selection/focus unless explicitly specified by the method contract, and persist restored divider geometry.
entries.windows_gap: Implemented but unverified. Existing pane_resize has useful relative/absolute logic, yet the per-surface/pane model migration can change pane identity/tree ancestry, and no frozen-canonical live differential proves exact errors, ancestor choice, pixel geometry, events, persistence, or multiwindow routing.

request.routing: shared selectors; pane_id else focused pane
request.type: terminal default; browser/markdown/filePreview/rightSidebarTool/agentSession tokens; unknown token falls back terminal
request.agent_session: provider_id then provider, default codex, valid codex|claude|claudecode|opencode; renderer_kind then renderer, default react, valid react|solid
request.terminal_browser: url, working_directory, initial_command, tmux_start_command, remote_pty_session_id, remote_context, startup_environment then initial_env, focus=false

entries.success: Workspace: window/workspace/pane/surface ids+refs and type. Dock: placement=dock, ordinary pane/surface ids+refs null, dock pane/surface ids and type. Remote/external use shared shapes.
entries.state_events_persistence: Appends a heterogeneous surface to one pane, initializes kind metadata/runtime, reconciles async attachment, emits one surface.created and optional selection, and persists kind-specific snapshot.
entries.windows_gap: missing exact method; separate new-terminal/browser helpers cannot provide agent-session/Dock/remote/error/payload/lifecycle parity without the model migration

entries.contract: Shared routing chooses a workspace/container; a surface selector chooses its owner but does not focus it. Return workspace focused surface, else first ordered surface, as window/workspace/pane/surface ids+refs plus surface_type. Empty container succeeds with null pane/surface/type. Errors unavailable then Workspace not found.
entries.state_events_persistence: read-only/no event; reflects restored/reconciled focus and heterogeneous type
entries.windows_gap: missing; current pane-selected/first-window inputs are insufficient

entries.contract: Shared routing; unavailable versus Workspace not found. Top-level workspace id/ref, ordered surfaces, window id/ref. Every row: id/ref/index/type/title/focused/pane_id/ref/index_in_pane/selected_in_pane. Browser may add developer_tools_visible. Terminal adds requested_working_directory, initial_command, tmux_start_command, resume_binding (explicit null/object).
critical_semantics: focused is workspace-wide focusedPanelId, not each pane's selected surface
kind-conditional fields are exact; Windows convenience fields do not substitute
multiwindow and Dock ownership/ref minting are exact
entries.windows_gap: Known deltas despite implementation: first-window routing, pane-selected marked focused, missing index_in_pane, pane refs derived from surface index, pane-wide kind/cwd assumptions, extra/noncanonical conditional fields, no live differential. Remains implemented_unverified.

entries.request: Shared routing; surface_id if resolvable, else the resolved workspace/Dock focused surface.
errors: not_found/Surface not found with surface_id data
internal_error/Failed to close surface with surface_id data
entries.success: Return closed workspace/surface/window ids+refs, preserving the identity of the surface that was removed.
entries.state_events_persistence: Close exactly once, tear down runtime and pending directory state, prune metadata/indexes, collapse empty pane, choose deterministic pane/surface focus fallback, emit lifecycle close/selection events once, and persist the resulting topology.
entries.windows_gap: Implemented but unverified. Current surface_close returns post-close surface.list shape, uses first-window/focused helpers, and lacks differential proof for last-surface protection, runtime cleanup, stale callbacks, metadata pruning, pane collapse, exact events, restore, and multiwindow ownership.

entries.request: Resolve TabManager first through shared routing, then require a resolvable surface_id. The target must belong to the resolved workspace/container.
errors: not_found/Surface not found with surface_id data
entries.success: Return window/workspace/surface ids+refs for the focused surface.
entries.state_events_persistence: Explicit focus-intent: focus owning window in-app, select owning workspace/pane/surface, update focus history/selected ids, emit selection events only for actual transitions, and preserve that selection in the session snapshot without activating another application.
entries.windows_gap: Implemented but unverified. Current handler returns {accepted,changed,...}, uses first-window/workspace helpers, and has no exact error/payload, Dock, focus-history, event multiplicity, app-activation, restart, or cross-window differential proof.

request.destination_precedence: before_surface_id or after_surface_id anchor; else pane_id; else workspace_id; else window_id selected workspace; else source workspace/pane
request.position: explicit index unless an anchor supplies before/after index

errors: invalid_params/Specify at most one of before_surface_id or after_surface_id
not_found/Surface, Anchor surface, Pane, Workspace, Window, selected workspace, or destination pane with exact identity data
internal_error/Failed to move surface or detach/attach destination

Cross-workspace/window move detaches the full heterogeneous surface transfer, attaches at destination, rolls back to original pane/index if attach fails, transfers runtime/metadata/pending directory ownership, optionally focuses destination, emits one move plus actual selection events, and persists both workspaces.

Current move has partial resolver/core support, but model migration can break pane identity and metadata transfer; no frozen-canonical proof covers anchor precedence, rollback, heterogeneous runtime transfer, exact errors/payload/events, focus, restore, or multiwindow move.

entries.request: Require workspace_id; optional syntactically valid surface_id; first nonblank raw string path,directory,cwd, preserving whitespace; all nonblank aliases must equal exactly.
entries.errors: Exact invalid workspace/surface, Missing path, Conflicting path parameters, Workspace not found or Surface not found with requested identity block.
entries.success: Recorded response returns resolved ids/refs and exact path. Empty remote workspace returns requested/null surface identity, exact path, pending=true.
entries.state_events_persistence: Resolve the reported-directory target; store directory/provenance, update workspace cwd only when eligible focused panel, update projections, or queue pending remote PWD and apply once on arrival. Persist panel directory/provenance; no completion event/focus change.

entries.request: Shared routing. command then initial_command trimmed, default exec ${SHELL:-/bin/zsh} -l; tmux_start_command defaults command; optional working_directory; surface_id presence is significant; focus if present must parse bool, default no explicit focus override.
entries.target_semantics: Present surface_id is located globally by exact surface identity and overrides routing fallback; invalid/unresolved gives Surface not found for the given surface_id. Without it resolve workspace then focused surface. Terminal-only.
errors: not_found/Surface not found for the given surface_id with optional id data
unavailable/Unable to access the cmux window or TabManager not available per localized frozen strings
invalid_params/Surface is not a terminal with id data
internal_error/Failed to respawn surface with id data

entries.platform_equivalence: Windows uses a native default shell and process invocation equivalent; exact canonical macOS shell text is not required on Windows, but empty/default versus explicit command, quoting, runtime replacement, identity, environment/cwd, errors, events, and persistence are.

entries.precedence: --action else first positional; action lowercases and replaces hyphens with underscores without trimming or rewriting spaces (frozen e1825d40 behavior); --tab over --surface and tab:N canonicalizes to surface:N; bare numeric workspace/surface selectors are zero-based indexes resolved through list calls; explicit workspace/window suppress inappropriate ambient CMUX_TAB_ID/CMUX_SURFACE_ID; window then workspace then tab normalization; absent workspace resolves workspace.current, while a workspace-only request omits surface for server focused resolution; focus always sent default false.
entries.errors_output: Exact parse/unknown flag/rename title/focus/normalizer errors. Calls tab.action. Text: OK action=... optional tab/workspace/closed/full_width_tab_mode/created/created_workspace; JSON and --id-format exact; no deprecation warning. Subcommand --help is byte-for-byte frozen help; bare `help` remains top-level and ignores following arguments.
entries.state_events_persistence: Pure façade; no shadow state or duplicate event.
entries.windows_gap: classified/help-classified only; no concrete help, mapping, formatting, process-contract test, or backend route

entries.precedence: Window command/global override; workspace explicit else CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID only without window; surface normalized in window/workspace with focused fallback. --command else trailing tokens after optional --; trim; empty defaults to exec ${SHELL:-/bin/zsh} -l.
entries.wire: Call surface.respawn with command=/bin/sh -c <single-quoted final command> and tmux_start_command=<unwrapped final command>, plus normalized ids. Windows must use a native shell-wrapper equivalent that preserves command text/quoting semantics.
entries.output: Backend errors nonzero; success text OK; JSON formatted payload; subcommand --help is byte-for-byte frozen help documenting flags/default focused surface. Windows runtime adapts only the POSIX shell launcher to a PowerShell-safe native ComSpec invocation; help wording requires no platform divergence.
entries.state_events_persistence: Pure façade over respawn; no separate process or session state.

differential_live_gate.canonical_fixture: Frozen e1825d40 tagged macOS app/socket: two windows, workspace and Dock panes, mixed terminal/browser/agent/markdown/file surfaces, pinned/unread/custom-title tabs, remote tmux/empty remote arrival fixture, event subscription, and restart snapshot.
differential_live_gate.windows_fixture: Isolated hosted Windows build/named pipe with real terminal/browser sidecars and equivalent public setup.
capture: create/arrival/close/move/respawn event timeline and duplicate/zombie detection
pane resize divider ancestry/geometry and restored layout
post-restart identities, heterogeneous metadata, runtime attachment, and transient-versus-persisted state

differential_live_gate.normalization: Symbolize UUID/ref identities by stable owner/creation order and treat native path/shell executable values as platform-equivalent only where stated. Do not normalize missing/extra fields, nulls, errors, counts, ordering, focus, geometry, events, timing, quoting behavior, or persistence.
differential_live_gate.promotion: Each entry remains missing or implemented_unverified until zero unexplained deltas exist for its acceptance surface on the exact independently verified pushed commit. The product entry promotes only after all thirteen constituent entries and the cross-entry lifecycle/restore scenarios pass.

batch_assessment.reason: All 14 entries read, create, replace, mutate, report against, resize, focus, close, or expose the same pane/surface identity and lifecycle. The product behavior is the cross-entry invariant; pane/surface create establish ownership, list/current consume it, PWD reconciles against arrival, action/respawn/close/focus/move/resize mutate it, restore reattaches it, and both CLIs are direct façades. Existing close/focus/move/resize rows must be reverified because the migration changes their underlying identities and tree.
